imports.note: stable-staker is a top-level pinned submodule under lib/ of phoenix-phase-2-staging; remappings canonicalize stable-staker/ -> lib/stable-staker/src/. Imported by both interaction scripts and (as `new StableStaker(...)`) by DeployMocks.
Imported by DeployMocks to deploy the 3 ERC4626 yield strategies wired into StableStaker.
Aliased in DeployMocks as IFlaxStaker; StableStaker constructor takes IFlax (MockPhUSD satisfies it).

functionsExercised.stake(address,uint256): StableStaker.sol:238 — STEP 1. nonReentrant/whenNotPaused/poolExists. Pulls principal, routes into yieldStrategy[token], updates userInfo.amount + poolInfo.totalStaked.
functionsExercised.withdraw(address,uint256): StableStaker.sol:258 — STEP 3. Decrements userInfo.amount + totalStaked, routes exit through strategy via _routeExit (ERC4626 assets->shares->assets rounding, protocol-favoured).
functionsExercised.claim(address): StableStaker.sol:287 — STEP 3. Settles pool via _updatePool and mints accrued phUSD reward to the user (StableStaker is an authorized phUSD minter).
functionsExercised.pendingReward(address,address): StableStaker.sol:543 — STEP 3 read; reward = elapsed * phusdPerSecond accrued via accPhusdPerShare.
functionsExercised.poolInfo(address): StableStaker.sol:62 (struct) — read for phusdPerSecond + totalStaked baseline in both scripts.
functionsExercised._updatePool(address): StableStaker.sol:604 — internal; accPhusdPerShare += elapsed*phusdPerSecond*ACC_PRECISION/totalStaked, dust rounds down.
functionsExercised._routeExit(address,uint256,bool): StableStaker.sol:669 — internal; ERC4626 strategy.withdraw round-trip, returns actual balanceDelta (<= requested; dust kept by strategy).

stableStakerSource.rewardAccounting: MasterChef-style accPhusdPerShare. Emission rate phusdPerSecond = phUSDPerDay/86400 (floored). _updatePool folds in elapsed*phusdPerSecond per update; dust always rounds DOWN so realized emission <= phUSDPerDay over any window (invariant noted in source header).
stableStakerSource.baselinePrincipalAccounting: poolInfo.totalStaked tracks aggregate principal; userInfo.amount tracks per-user principal. Principal lives inside the ERC4626 strategy when one is set; on withdraw, totalStaked decrements by the requested amount (returns to baseline) while tokens forwarded to wallet may be a few wei short due to ERC4626 share rounding (kept protocol-side).

offChainState.role: address-handoff between deploy and interaction scripts

assertions.enforcedIn: Solidity require() in the interaction scripts (a revert -> non-zero exit -> shell `set -e` aborts). There are NO shell-level numeric assertions; the shell only checks process exit codes.

checks: require(pending > 0, "no reward accrued - did time advance via evm_increaseTime?")
rewardThreshold.rationale: ~10 phUSD = one full day at the DOLA pool rate; 1% upper band absorbs the handful of extra seconds (block mining between stake and claim), small lower band absorbs integer-division dust.

checks: require(principalDust <= 10, "principal returned short by more than rounding dust") where principalDust = STAKE_AMOUNT - returned
principalRestored.rationale: ERC4626 assets->shares->assets round-trip in ERC4626YieldStrategy rounds in the protocol's favour, so the wallet may be <=10 wei short; userInfo principal is nonetheless fully cleared.

baselineRestored.check: require(totalStakedFinal == baseline) where baseline = totalStakedNow - STAKE_AMOUNT (re-derived pre-stake total)
